header: Standards audited on the fleet and in the depots
subheadline: Every certificate below is re-audited on a fixed cycle and the reports go to any shipper who asks for them. Two of them are the reason bonded loads and medicinal stock can travel on the same scheduled network without a separate approval.

certifications.name: ISO 9001:2015
certifications.description: Quality management across dispatch, linehaul and claims handling, re-audited every September since 2012.

certifications.name: GDP for medicinal products
certifications.description: Covers the 2 to 8 °C fleet, the Basel depot and driver training for temperature excursions.

certifications.name: AEO-F customs status
certifications.description: Trusted-trader status on both the customs and the security criteria, valid at 11 border crossings.
